name: @dsh-toolset/code-map
description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）进程内集成插件：代码结构地图（结构索引 + 调用图候选 + 项目/模块报告）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-code-map && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-code-map && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-code-map node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-code-map tmp/cov-code-map/report.json
